r144/ordinary-terminal-select-primal.question: Can we construct or select an optimizer on the actual mean-one face with sublinear terminal activation?
r144/ordinary-terminal-select-primal.scope: For each sufficiently small fixed tau>0 and each ordinary sign s, along all p=1 mod 4 primes p tending to infinity, there is a choice of a genuine mean-one optimum F on sign s and T=T(p) tending to infinity with T+1 in the proved simultaneous marked window for which E[1_bulk F sqrt(n) g_T]=o(T), with n=(p-1)/2 and g_T the actual fixed-tau zero-start activation increment. The tau limit follows the prime limit. Use the primal side and keep the exact root optimum throughout.
r144/ordinary-terminal-select-primal.remaining: Obtain a prime-uniform o(T) upper on the minimum weighted actual terminal activation or its exact reduced dual, each sign at selectable growing time. Keep the floor fixed until after the prime limit.
